ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 65% high-intensity pixels (white/cream) vs 35% low-intensity pixels (black/dark-gray) across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions dominate both lateral lobes. A central low-intensity (dark) wedge extends from the peduncle base. A prominent dark diagonal linear cluster is located on the inner-lower quadrant of the left lobe. Dark stippling is concentrated along the distal and trailing margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; visible pixel angle approximately 45 degrees; vertex depth is partially obscured by water surface turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the trailing boundary. The right lobe exhibits a more consistent sawtooth pattern, while the left lobe shows coarser, more irregular peaks and a deep indentation near the terminal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a concave upward trajectory terminating in tapered distal tips that curve toward the anterior plane.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Sparse distribution of localized dark circular pixel clusters on the white fields of both the left and right lobes, likely representing barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark diagonal linear interruption of the white pigmentation on the inner left lobe; secondary vertical linear markings visible on the inner right lobe near the notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant morphological irregularity on the far-left tip characterized by jagged tissue loss and brownish/reddish pixel discoloration, indicating physical trauma or amputation.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'slashing' dark pigmentation mark on the inner white field of the left lobe.
